refinement_results.note: Adaptation-order seeds from one fixed warm-start donor and frozen PA; same previously inspected capture. Not independent captures, PA evaluators or end-to-end retraining seeds.

reference_comparison.scope: Same-data native-method reconstruction, not reproduction of Hu et al. hardware results. Original 160 MHz OpenDPD input and splits remain unchanged. 158 RVTDCNN parameters versus 1406 CNN parameters (joint methods additionally tune 24 complex GMP coefficients); unequal training budgets/objectives. Three alternate surrogate initializations use the same physical PA capture and are not three devices. One DPD seed; no test-based selection or claim of matched-capacity superiority. Original 100 MHz Doherty data/code/weights unavailable.

reference_integrity.scope: Native-method reconstruction on OpenDPD; unequal training budget. Cascade uses the same frozen PA and train-peak limiter. Original Hu hardware/captures/weights are unavailable.
